results.caption:
Your ferritin comes back at 29.

Again.

And by the time you get to me, you’re not casually curious anymore. You’re pissed.

Because you’ve done what you were told. You took the iron. Changed brands when it made you constipated. Added vitamin C. Ate the steak. Moved your coffee. Maybe you even sat through an infusion.

But you’re still pulling handfuls of hair out of the shower drain. You’re still exhausted before lunch. Your workouts feel embarrassing compared to what your body used to handle. And somewhere along the way, you started wondering:

“Is this just who I am now?”

No. When I see ferritin under 30, I have five questions running through my head.

And none of them start with “Which iron should we try next?”

Because ferritin is giving me a clue. I want to know what happened before that number got there. What keeps pulling it back down. What else in your story doesn’t make sense yet.

That’s the part women are usually missing.

You’ve been handed individual puzzle pieces for years. The heavy periods went to one provider. The gut problems went to another. The thyroid symptoms got their own appointment. The exhaustion got blamed on being a busy mom.

But nobody put the entire puzzle on the table.

That’s what we do differently.

Inside your Roadmap, we use your history, genetics and deep investigation labs to find the connections hiding underneath your symptoms.

Because you don’t need another wellness hack.

You need to finally understand why YOUR body keeps ending up here.

Comment TRANSFORM if you’ve hit your FU**-IT threshold* and you’re ready for deeper answers.
